content.short: NFTScan is a professional NFT explorer and API platform providing comprehensive NFT data across Mantle and 20+ blockchain networks.
content.description: NFTScan is a specialized NFT data platform and blockchain explorer that provides comprehensive tracking of NFT collections, transactions, and wallet holdings across more than 20 blockchain networks including Mantle. The platform offers a professional-grade NFT API for developers building NFT-centric applications, covering collection metadata, ownership history, transfer events, and market statistics. NFTScan's explorer tools allow users to browse all NFT activity on Mantle Network with detailed analytics and historical data.
